utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa, I’m keeping the repair drive list by location—do you have any items coming from your place, or any drop-off/pickup spots I should mark down?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—that’s exactly the kind of order we need. For now, please mark my porch as a temporary drop-off spot, and I’ll send you the urgent addresses once Uli and Nell’s notes come in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll mark your porch as a temporary drop-off spot for now, and I’ll wait for the urgent addresses from Uli and Nell’s notes before adding those.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Quinn, I’m still waiting on the confirmed time and place, but what I’ve heard so far is the repair drive may focus on leaky gutters and broken porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell — I’ll tell folks the focus may be gutters and porch steps, but I’ll hold off on any time or place until you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds perfect, Quinn—please keep it tentative for now, and I’ll pass along the confirmed time and place as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rey, I’m starting the supplies list now: railing first, then the garden hose bib. Do you know if anyone nearby has exterior screws, a wrench set, or plumber’s tape to spare?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet, Cleo, but I can quietly ask the few people closest by and note who has screws, a wrench set, or plumber’s tape before evening.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—that would help a lot. If anyone has extras, please note their name and what they can spare so I can keep the list tidy.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Hana, for the repair drive I’ve got railing first, then the leaky hose bib—I'll bring a wrench, pliers, and screws if my toolbox hasn’t wandered off again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren—just to be clear, are you saying those are your priority repairs to handle, and should I mark you down as bringing those tools once you’ve checked your toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, that’s right—mark me for the railing first and hose bib after, and pencil me in for wrench, pliers, and screws once I confirm the toolbox is actually where I think it is.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Noah, I’m still waiting on confirmed locations, but I’m checking with the school office and a few parents at pickup today; if the drive lands around 3:30 to 5, I should be able to help after the kids are settled.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye—that helps, and I won’t treat the location as settled yet. I’ll check the signup sheet too, and if Saturday afternoon still needs hands, I can probably cover part of that window.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah, that would be great—once I hear back from the school office and parents today, I’ll pass along anything solid so we’re not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Uli, I’m getting things ready for the repair drive—Sam’s helping with tables and cords Saturday morning, and I’ve got my toolbox set aside if we need extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus—that helps a lot. I’m keeping things simple for now, just gathering names and urgent fixes, so your toolbox may be just what we need Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Uli—I’ll be there Saturday morning with the toolbox, and if you get a list of urgent fixes before then, just point me where I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, I’m just back from errands and still listening for repair drive updates—have you heard whether they’ve posted a list of fixes or set any times yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet, Ira—Rey’s supposed to bring names, skills, and the top three repairs tonight, and Pia’s checking the community room. Do you have any tools or a time you can actually help?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can spare a couple hours Saturday morning, and I’ve got basic hand tools I can bring. I’ll keep listening for Rey’s list and Pia’s room update so we know where to plug in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Vik—I’m still waiting on a firm time and a proper list of repairs before I commit. If you hear anything definite, I’d appreciate you passing it along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Morning, Eli—same here, I’m still waiting on the firm time, place, and repair list. Once Nell or anyone else confirms it, I’ll pass it along to you and the block.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik—that’s exactly the sort of clear word I’m waiting for. Once we have the time, place, and list, I can decide how best to help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Tess, I’m helping with tables and tool bins Saturday morning, and I’m bringing a couple extension cords—anything else you need me to cover for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Sam, that’s wonderful—tables, bins, and cords are exactly the sort of things folks forget until the last minute. I’m still waiting on the confirmed kickoff time, so for now I’d say just keep your morning flexible and I’ll pass along the firm details as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess—I’ll keep Saturday morning open and wait for the confirmed time. Thanks for keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll check the posted notice and ask the building office about the community room before we tell anyone; I don’t want people showing up with the wrong items or no space to work.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Pia—can you confirm both the time and the accepted items once you hear back from the office?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I’ll confirm the time, accepted items, and whether the community room is actually available before we share anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m late catching up—I'm already set to cover a sign-in shift and text a few folks, but do you know if they still need hands for sorting or hauling later?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, sorting still helps, and hauling would be useful around late morning. If you can spare an hour after sign-in, I’ll point you where needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Leo—I’ll plan to stick around for an hour after sign-in and can help with sorting or hauling wherever you point me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Bo, we’re still gathering items and volunteers for the repair drive, so there’s room to jump in if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m a little slammed, but I can bring a couple extension cords and help with check-in for the first hour Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, Bo—thank you. I’ll put you down for extension cords and check-in for the first hour Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Dane. I’m waiting on a firm time and a posted list for the repair drive before I commit—have you heard anything definite yet?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Morning, Eli — I haven’t heard a firm time yet either, just that they still need sorting help and someone at sign-in. I already offered to take a sign-in shift, so I’ll pass along the posted list as soon as I see it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane—that helps. If you see the list or a proper start time posted, send it my way and I’ll decide where I can fit in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Bo, I’m trying to work the repair drive around school pickup, but I don’t have confirmed locations yet. I’m checking with the office and a few parents today, so I can pass along solid details once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Faye—just send me the confirmed spot when you’ve got it. I’m planning to bring a couple extension cords and help check-in for the first hour Saturday if that still fits.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo—that sounds really helpful. I’ll confirm the spot after pickup today and let you know whether that first hour still lines up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Gus, we still need spare tools and one more person for check-in Saturday morning. Can you bring anything or cover a short shift?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Leo — I can bring my spare drill set, hand tools, and an extension cord, and I’ll cover a short check-in shift Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus—that covers a big gap. Please bring them by Saturday morning and I’ll put you on check-in for the first short shift.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, I’m already helping Saturday morning with tables, tool bins, and sorting donated tools, plus I’m bringing a couple extension cords—anything else you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sam, that’s already a huge help—thank you. If you can also bring a roll of masking tape and a marker for labeling tool bins, we’ll be in good shape Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Rosa—I’ll bring masking tape and a marker along with the extension cords on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Uli—before we make any plans, can you tell me what you’ve heard about the repair drive so far and whether you’ve seen the latest signup sheet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve mostly heard about small appliances and a few leaky fixtures, and Rey’s going to quietly sort tools and note what’s missing. I haven’t seen the latest signup sheet yet, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli—that helps, but let’s hold off on assigning anyone until we’ve checked the latest signup sheet. Can you ask Rey to share the tool gaps once they’ve sorted things?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Cleo, I’m sending over the repair drive details now—kickoff time still isn’t confirmed, so I’ll flag that and loop in nearby folks for tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—send them over and I’ll mark the kickoff time as pending on the supplies list. Once neighbors reply, I’ll track who can bring the wrench, pliers, spare screws, and anything for that hose bib.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Cleo—I'll keep the time clearly marked as pending and start nudging the nearby folks for those tools and hose bib bits now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, can you ask the building office about the community room today, and I’ll start a tool list—who do you already know has basics like drills, wrenches, or sewing kits?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I’ll ask the building office today about the room and any rules. For tools, I think Tomas has a drill, June has wrenches, and I can bring a small sewing kit—but let’s confirm before counting on them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please confirm Tomas and June today, and ask the office about hours, cleanup rules, and whether we can use extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I’m just back from errands and heard folks are still gathering names and repair needs—have you heard whether they’ve posted a list or set any times yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I haven’t confirmed anything yet, Ira—Pia was going to check the notice for the actual time and what they’ll accept before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Kira—that sounds sensible. If Pia spots the time or the accepted repairs, let me know and I’ll help spread the word while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, I’m still piecing together the repair drive details—Nell’s checking with Marisol on the time and place, and Dane said he can help later with sorting or hauling if that’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Vik—thanks for pulling those threads together. Once Nell and Marisol confirm the time and place, I can help match folks to sorting, hauling, sign-in, and repair roles so we’re not scrambling.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Jules—I’ll pass that along once Nell gets the time and place from Marisol, and I’ll let Dane know sorting or hauling may be where he’s most useful later.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Tess, I’ve got railing first and hose bib second on my note—do you know if 3:30 to 5 is still the repair window, before I tell Faye for certain?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I wouldn’t tell Faye for certain just yet, Oren—I still haven’t heard that 3:30 to 5 is confirmed. I’ll ask around and holler as soon as I’ve got the firm window.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess—I'll hold off telling Faye it's firm, then. I'll just keep hunting for my wrench and wait for your holler.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Rey, we’re still gathering repair items and volunteers for the drive, and Noah said he can likely help Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara—I’ll mark Noah for Saturday afternoon and keep asking quietly for names, skills, and the most urgent repairs so I can bring Mina a clear list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Rey—if you get any urgent repair details before tonight, send them my way too so I can help match volunteers with the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Nell, I’m logging repair-drive locations carefully—do you have any confirmed pickup spots or items that need to be routed to the community room?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Opal — I don’t have any confirmed pickup spots yet, just second-hand notes about gutters and porch steps being priorities. I’m still waiting to hear the actual logistics, and I’ll pass them along once I know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell — I’ll note gutters and porch steps as unconfirmed priorities, with no pickup spots confirmed yet. Please send me the actual locations and routing details once you have them.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
